dataset.name: Primary Land Use Tax Lot Output (PLUTO)

parameters.$where: cd in ('102','108') and bbl is not null and address is not null and borocode is not null and block is not null and lot is not null

query.selectionRule: Parse PLUTO parcels with the same address/component checks as bulk registration, preserve bbl ASC order, exclude non-condo parcels whose Building Footprints candidates would fail identifier agreement, and take the first 10,000.
